name: Customer asset custody (hot + cold wallets)
description: Customer crypto assets you hold for them — segregated wallets, hot wallets for liquidity, cold storage for the bulk. Loss, theft, misappropriation and key-management failures are existential risks.

name: On-chain transaction flows
description: Inbound and outbound crypto transactions linking your customers to the wider blockchain ecosystem — including counterparties on sanctioned wallets, mixers, darknet markets, and high-risk exchanges.

name: Fiat on-ramp / off-ramp
description: SEPA, card and bank-rail flows used by customers to fund or withdraw from your platform. Touches AML, sanctions, fraud and PSP liability.

name: Retail crypto customers
description: Individuals trading or holding crypto. Subject to MiCA suitability, complaints, and consumer-protection regimes alongside AML checks.

name: Institutional / corporate customers
description: Corporates, funds, OTC desks. Higher value, more complex beneficial-ownership and source-of-funds reviews; potential PEP and high-risk-jurisdiction concentration.

name: Travel-rule counterparties
description: Other VASPs / CASPs you transact with under the FATF Travel Rule and the EU Transfer of Funds Regulation. Verifying beneficiary information is mandatory.

name: Listed token catalogue
description: Every token you make available is a market-abuse, fraud, sanctions and regulatory exposure. New listings need a pre-trade risk review.
